question: In an n-type semiconductor, the donor atom concentration is much greater than the intrinsic carrier concentration. Explain why electrons dominate the conduction process.

options.A: Donor atoms create holes, so holes dominate conduction in n-type semiconductor.
options.B: Electrons and holes are always present in equal numbers regardless of donor concentration.
options.C: High donor concentration prevents all electrons from becoming mobile, so holes dominate conduction.
options.D: In n-type semiconductor, pentavalent donor atoms contribute many extra free electrons. When donor concentration greatly exceeds intrinsic carrier concentration, donor electrons far outnumber thermally generated holes, so electrons are majority carriers and dominate conduction.
